question: How many locally acquired human West Nile virus cases will ECDC report for Italy in 2026 in the weekly update published on or around 18 September 2026?

calls.reasoning: ECDC's Italy row mirrors ISS national bulletins with a small negative offset (ECDC 139/311/516 vs ISS 141/312/521). The resolving 18 Sep ECDC report should reflect the ISS bulletin dated ~17 Sep, i.e. two further weekly increments on top of 516. 2026 is tracking 2025 almost exactly in level (432 vs 430 on ~27 Aug) but with slightly hotter recent increments (+120, +89 vs +79, +72). Applying 2025's 4-Sep-to-18-Sep shape (502->582->647, ratio 1.29) to 521 gives ~672 ISS; scaling 2025's next-two-week increments (+80, +65) by the ~1.1-1.25 factor 2026 has been running gives ~684-695 ISS, minus ~4 for the ECDC offset. Increments have already turned over (120 -> 89), and in both 2024 and 2025 mid-September sat at ~0.79-0.83 of the season total, so continued but decaying accumulation is the status quo. Downside: faster autumn decay plus a widening ECDC-vs-ISS reporting lag. Upside: a batch addition of retrospectively confirmed blood-donor/asymptomatic cases, of which Italy has an unusually high share this year, or a warm mid-September extending transmission. No prediction market prices this (checked Polymarket/Manifold via harness, plus my own searches of Kalshi/bookmakers: none found), so no crowd anchor. Reaching the open upper bound of 1100 would require ~+584 in two weeks, roughly 5x the largest weekly increment ever observed in Italy, so no escape mass declared.
calls.dossier:
RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off the Italy row of ECDC's weekly human WNV dashboard (wnv-weekly.ecdc.europa.eu, surfaced at ecdc.europa.eu/en/west-nile-fever/surveillance-and-disease-data/disease-data-ecdc), NOT off the ISS national bulletin and NOT off ECDC's separate monthly human+animal report. ECDC publishes Fridays; the resolving report is the first dated on/after 17 Sep 2026.

EVENT WINDOW: last published ECDC update was dated 4 Sep 2026 -> resolving update expected 18 Sep 2026, a 14-day accumulation window per the criteria; as of Now (2026-09-07T12:50Z) 3 of 14 days elapsed = ~21%.

STATUS QUO OUTCOME: the count only moves upward and only via new weekly reporting; with no further reporting it stays at the 4 Sep value of 516.

EVIDENCE (source, date):
- ECDC weekly dashboard, Italy locally acquired 2026: 139 (data to 5 Aug), 224 (~17 Aug), 311 (~21 Aug), 516 (report dated 4 Sep 2026). Greece second at 284 on 4 Sep; ~1,086 cases across 15 countries.
- ISS Bollettino WND 2026 series (epicentro.iss.it/westnile/bollettino), confirmed human cases: #1 28 Jul = 84; #2 6 Aug = 141; #3 13 Aug = 226; #4 20 Aug = 312; #5 27 Aug = 432; #6 3 Sep (data to 2 Sep) = 521, incl. 269 neuroinvasive, 179 fever, 70 asymptomatic blood-donor detections, 26 deaths, circulation in 75 provinces / 19 regions.
- Implied ISS weekly increments 2026: +57, +85, +86, +120, +89.
- ECDC-vs-ISS offset on matched data cuts, 2026: 139 vs 141; 311 vs 312; 516 vs 521 (ECDC below ISS by 1-5; ISS totals include a small number of imported cases).
- ISS 2026 bulletin cadence: Tuesday for #1, then Thursdays (6, 13, 20, 27 Aug, 3 Sep). Next bulletins fall ~10 Sep and ~17 Sep 2026, each with data cut ~1-2 days earlier.
- BASE RATE, class = Italian season 2025 by ISS bulletin (iss.it press releases + epicentro bulletin index): 89 (31 Jul), 351 (20-21 Aug), 430 (28 Aug), 502 (4 Sep), 582 (11 Sep), 647 (18 Sep), 680 (25 Sep). ECDC end-of-season 2025 total for Italy: 779 locally acquired (data to 3 Dec 2025).
- BASE RATE, class = Italian season 2024: 382 human cases as of the 18-19 Sep 2024 ISS bulletin (with 51 new cases in the 12-18 Sep week); ISS full-2024 total 484 confirmed (266 neuroinvasive, 36 deaths); ECDC 2024 locally acquired for Italy ~455-460.
- BASE RATE conditional on reaching mid-September: mid-Sep cumulative was ~0.83 of the ECDC season total in 2025 (647/779) and ~0.79 of the ISS season total in 2024 (382/484).
- BASE RATE conditional on the first-September-week level: the 4 Sep -> 18 Sep 2025 cumulative growth ratio was 1.289; the analogous 2024 ratio is higher (2024 cumulative was ~331 on 11 Sep, implying a materially larger two-week ratio).
- 2026 vs 2025 level comparison at matched dates: ISS 432 on 27 Aug 2026 vs 430 on 28 Aug 2025; ISS 521 on 2 Sep 2026 vs 502 on 4 Sep 2025. Neuroinvasive case fatality 7.2-7.7% in 2026 vs 13.9% same period 2025 (ISS bulletin #5/#6), consistent with broader/milder ascertainment in 2026 including blood-donor screening.
- SERIES SPREAD, class = 2026 ISS weekly increments to date: observed range 57-120 per week; the two-week sums realised so far in 2026 are +142 (to 13 Aug from 28 Jul... ), +171 (20 Aug->3 Sep window equivalents), i.e. two-week totals have run roughly 140-210 during the peak.
- EVENT-IN-WINDOW CHECK, class = ECDC weekly publication: ECDC published a Friday human weekly update in every week of the June-November season in 2024 and 2025; no missed week identified in 2026 through 4 Sep. Searched for an announced ECDC publication pause or schedule change for Sep 2026: none found.
- Counter-signal (upward): commentary and Italian regional reporting describe an extended risk season now running from early summer into late autumn, warm-winter/early-summer mosquito dynamics, and virus circulation newly documented in 19 regions / 75 provinces in 2026 vs 17 regions / 66 provinces a week earlier - geographic expansion still in progress as of 3 Sep 2026.
- Counter-signal (downward): the weekly increment already turned over (+120 in the week to 27 Aug, +89 in the week to 2 Sep); in both 2024 and 2025 the late-September weekly increment collapsed sharply (2025 fell to +33 in the week to 23 Sep); some local health authorities (e.g. ASL Napoli 2 Nord) report 2026 counts below their 2025 equivalents.
- A 2026 commentary paper (PMC13505423) argues Italy faces a national-data 'information blackout' and that observers must rely on ECDC/EFSA; note this claim sits alongside ISS in fact publishing weekly bulletins on schedule through 3 Sep 2026. Treat as contested framing, not as evidence of a reporting stoppage.

SEARCHED FOR BUT COULD NOT FIND: any prediction market or bookmaker contract on European/Italian WNV case counts (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi, bookmakers - none found); the machine-readable ECDC weekly country table (dashboard is an embedded widget that did not render to text); the exact ISS cumulative figure in the 5 Sep 2024 bulletin (#11 of 2024), which would pin the 2024 two-week ratio precisely; any published ECDC statement on the 2026 dashboard's end-of-season cutoff date; any ISS bulletin dated after 3 Sep 2026 (none exists as of Now).
calls.reference_class: Italian WNV transmission seasons 2018-2025 under ISS/ECDC weekly surveillance: cumulative locally acquired human case count at the mid-September report relative to the count at the first-week-of-September report (2025: 502->647, ratio 1.29; 2024: ~270->382; mid-Sep = ~0.79-0.83 of season total)

calls.reasoning: Italy's ECDC row is a near-copy of the ISS weekly bulletin: 312 (19 Aug) -> 432 (26 Aug) -> 521 (2 Sep) vs ECDC 311 -> ~430 -> 516. The 18 Sep ECDC update should carry the ISS cut of ~16 Sep, i.e. two more weekly increments off 516. Reference class = Italy's own 14-day early-to-mid-September growth ratio in prior seasons: 1.29 (2025), ~1.29 (2022), ~1.4 (2024), ~1.5 (2018) -> anchor ~1.35x = ~697; 2025 is the tightest calendar/level analogue (432 vs 430 at 26 Aug) and implies ~665. Momentum is already decelerating (+120 then +89, ratio 0.74); pure geometric continuation gives ~632, while a 2025-shaped bump gives ~690, so I centre at 665. Downside tail covers a stale or partial ECDC dashboard refresh (one week of accrual instead of two, ~605-620); upside covers a warm-September extension of transmission and the broader 19-region spread. No prediction market prices this contract anywhere I could find, so no crowd anchor.

Italy's ECDC row has tracked the ISS bulletin closely: ISS 312 (data to 19 Aug 2026) vs ECDC 311 (~21 Aug); ISS 521 (data to 2 Sep) vs ECDC 516 (update 4 Sep, areas as of 3 Sep). The small gap is consistent with ECDC excluding imported cases (ISS totals include at least one imported death).

EVENT WINDOW: 2026 Italian transmission season (first locally acquired onsets 12-27 May 2026 per ECDC monthly, data to 24 June 2026) -> data cut of the ECDC report dated on/after 17 Sep 2026 (expected ~16-17 Sep). As of 2026-09-07 roughly 93% of that window has elapsed; the last published observation (ECDC 4 Sep, data to 3 Sep) leaves about 14 days of further accrual.

2026 OBSERVED SERIES (ISS weekly bulletins, epicentro.iss.it/westnile/bollettino; bulletin dates 28 Jul, 6 Aug, 13 Aug, 20 Aug, 27 Aug, 3 Sep):
- data to 19 Aug 2026: 312 confirmed human cases, 13 deaths (Adnkronos, 20 Aug 2026)
- data to 26 Aug 2026: 432 cases (+120 in the week), 17 deaths, neuroinvasive 223, blood donors 63, fever 144 (Quotidiano del Sud, 27 Aug 2026)
- data to 2 Sep 2026: 521 cases (+89 in the week), 26 deaths, neuroinvasive 269, blood donors 70, fever 179; 75 provinces in 19 regions (FNOB / Italpress, 3-6 Sep 2026)
- ECDC weekly, 4 Sep 2026: 15 countries, 1 086 locally acquired cases EU/EEA-wide; Italy 516, Greece 284 (11 unknown place of infection); 144 affected areas of which 62 in Italy
- ECDC earlier 2026 Italy points: 2 cases (data to 24 Jun), 46 (data to 22 Jul), 139 (data to 5 Aug)

BASE RATES / PRIOR-SEASON ANALOGUES (all Italy, same instruments):
- Over the 2025 season (ISS, the closest calendar-and-level analogue): 430 at 26 Aug -> 502 at 2 Sep (+72) -> 582 at 9 Sep (+80) -> 647 at 16 Sep (+65) -> 680 at 23 Sep (+33) -> 718 at 30 Sep (+38) -> 779 locally acquired at ECDC season end (data to 3 Dec 2025). Ratio of the 16 Sep figure to the 2 Sep figure: 1.29. The 16 Sep figure was 83% of the season total.
- Over the 2022 season (ECDC weekly): Italy 383 as of 7 Sep -> 536 as of 28 Sep; +82 Italian cases in the week to 7 Sep, +62 in the week to 28 Sep. Linear interpolation puts ~21 Sep near 490, a ~1.28 fourteen-day ratio.
- Over the 2024 season: Italy ~382 human cases as of 18 Sep 2024 after +51 that week (ISS via Outbreak News Today), against a season total near 460 — implying a mid-September fourteen-day ratio around 1.4.
- Over the 2018 season (ECDC): Italy 453 as of 20 Sep 2018, with +92 Italian cases in the single week 14-20 Sep; Italy's 2018 season total was 576. A later-peaking curve than 2025/2026.
- Conditional on the season being a high-count Italian year (2018, 2022, 2025), the 14-day early-to-mid-September ratio has fallen in the 1.28-1.5 band; conditional on the 2 September level being near 500 (only 2025 and 2026 qualify), the single observed ratio is 1.29.

EVIDENCE POINTING TOWARD CONTINUED FAST ACCRUAL:
- Weekly increments in 2026 have exceeded the matching 2025 weeks (+120 vs 2025's step into 430; +89 vs 2025's +72).
- Geographic footprint is wider than 2025 at the same date: 75 provinces / 19 regions (2026, 2 Sep) vs 72 provinces / 17 regions (2025, 16 Sep); 62 of ECDC's 144 European affected areas are Italian.
- ECDC/EFSA noted weather conditions favourable to transmission and expected further human cases in coming weeks (monthly report, data to 5 Aug 2026); Italian coverage on 3 Sep 2026 (LaPresse) attributed the arbovirus picture partly to sustained heat.
- Detection channels are broad: 70 of the 521 cases are asymptomatic blood donors, and neuroinvasive CFR is 7.7% in 2026 vs 13.9% in the same period of 2025, consistent with more mild-case ascertainment.

EVIDENCE POINTING TOWARD DECELERATION:
- The week-on-week increment ratio already turned down: +120 then +89 (0.74).
- In every prior Italian season the increment collapses through late September (2025: +65 then +33; 2022 Italy fell from +82/week to +62/week).
- Transmission is temperature-driven and Culex activity in the Po Valley declines through September; ECDC describes the season as roughly June-November with the peak in August-September.

DATA-PUBLICATION RISKS TO NOTE:
- A 2026 commentary (PMC13505423) describes an Italian 'information blackout' earlier in the season — delayed national bulletins attributed to privacy/decree issues in standing up new digital surveillance platforms; ISS weekly bulletins did resume from 28 Jul 2026 and have been published weekly since.
- The ECDC landing page carried a 'Page last updated 21 August 2026' stamp when fetched on 7 Sep 2026, with the live table served inside an iframe; the underlying weekly table was nonetheless current to 3-4 Sep.
- The criteria's fine print handles a skipped week (use the next update) and dashboard discontinuation (annul).

MARKETS: no prediction market or bookmaker contract on this quantity was located on Polymarket, Manifold, or Kalshi.

calls.reconciliation: Disputed: (a) 2025's 18-Sep ISS total - Runs 1 and 2 both retrieved 647, Run 3 interpolated ~630; I take 647 (two independent retrievals, consistent with the 582/680 bracket), which raises the 2025 two-week ratio from 1.26 to 1.289. (b) Whether the resolving ECDC report carries one or two ISS weeks - settled from the dossiers' matched pairs (ISS 141/312/521 vs ECDC 139/311/516, each a same-week Friday print), so two weeks is the base case and Run 3's 10% stale-report weight is trimmed to ~6-7% in the left tail. (c) Increment extrapolation - pure JUDGMENT, no evidence breaks it: Run 1's 1.15-1.25x premium on 2025 is not supported by the cumulative levels (521 vs 502, ~4% apart, with the excess concentrated in a single +120 catch-up week), while Runs 2/3's 0.74/week geometric decay exceeds any observed Italian post-peak decay (2025 was +80 -> +65, ~-19%); I bet on a mild premium over the 2025 shape, +80 then +68. (d) ECDC-ISS offset - Run 3's 'ISS minus declared imported' mechanism is right and matches the observed offsets of 2, 1 and 5; I subtract ~6 by mid-September. (e) Whether 2018's ~1.5 ratio belongs in the class - judgment; downweighted as a later-shifted season but kept as right-tail support.
